Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished, extremely legible full desktop application screenshot, landscape 2560 x 1560 approximately, matching the 1.642 aspect of the simulator reference. Flat front-on UI, no device frame, no collage. Portuguese (Portugal), pre-1990 orthography for new interface copy.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the authoritative visual reference and the simulator shell to preserve. Image 2 is the older Mission Control screen, authoritative ONLY for central content and functional structure. Replace its entire old dark-green navigation with Image 1's REAL simulator shell. Do not reproduce a dark green sidebar or large SPEE logotype.
SHELL INVARIANTS: Reproduce Image 1's light grey left sidebar at approx 18% width, its section bands, thin grey separators, original order, exact text, proportions, and cyan square module icons. ALL THIRTEEN original entries must be fully visible and readable, with none omitted, renamed or added:
top brand "Simulador Empresarial" and cyan hamburger;
section "MENU INICIAL";
"Início"
"Meu Perfil"
"Assistente SPEE"
"Gestor Documental"
"Banca"
"Email"
"Catálogo de Empresas"
"Concursos Públicos"
"Projeção de Preços" [preserve exact screenshot spelling];
section "RECURSOS AUXILIARES";
"Roteiro de Tarefas" [cyan anchor icon; subtle pale-cyan active highlight allowed]
"Modelo de Negócio" [cyan calculator icon];
grey separator band;
"SGC Gestão Comercial" [cyan calculator icon]
"RH Online Recursos Humanos" [cyan people icon].
Keep simulator top bar with "Eureka 101", globe "PORTUGUÊS", magnifier "PESQUISAR", avatar and "vali.issufo@gmail.com", "SAIR". Keep light grey ITIS footer and small green help bubble clear of content. Do not add Mission Control items to the sidebar. Put all task-specific navigation inside central content.

Green only for completed states; amber for pending; red for errors. Use light modern sans-serif typography close to the screenshot, sober institutional UI, crisp high-contrast small text, spacious cards, mild radius 4-8px, no oversized decorative gradients. Central panels use the full remaining width.
Replace ONLY central page content with requested Mission Control screen. Preserve exact ordered simulator sidebar and coherent top/header/footer across the whole series. Central page header must identify the correct role. Small text "PROTÓTIPO · DADOS ILUSTRATIVOS" visible on the central header. Content must be genuinely readable and accurately spelt. Preserve original state meanings, no invented buttons or new features. Requested screen details follow.

Central header small "MISSION CONTROL DO ESTUDANTE", main "Meu Percurso", subtitle "Veja o que está feito, o que falta e qual é o próximo passo." Right green dot and "Dados sincronizados".
Full-width progress card "Progresso global da simulação", "3 marcos confirmados", blue progress bar at "18%", link "Ver percurso completo".
Below wide left stack and narrower right "Resumo do bloco".
Left block card "Bloco actual", "Constituição", "1 de 4 actividades concluídas", progress 25%, info "Algumas actividades podem decorrer em paralelo."

"Registar empresa" / "Submeter os elementos para registo da empresa." / blue or amber "Em curso" / blue button "Continuar";
"Convidar sócios" / "Enviar convites e validar a participação." / turquoise "Disponível" / blue button "Iniciar actividade";
"Início de actividades" / "Comunicar o início de actividades às entidades competentes." / grey lock "Bloqueado", explanation "Requer a constituição concluída", disabled "Bloqueado" button.
Right "Resumo do bloco": "1 concluída", "1 em curso", "1 disponível", "1 bloqueada", appropriate textual status and icons; "Ver percurso completo" button.
Bottom internal block navigation "Ideação" with green "Concluído", "Constituição" with "Bloco actual", "Primeiro ano fiscal". Keep all copy and all sidebar menu entries legible.
